title: Bliss Film
description: A reinvigoration of the Bliss Film Production Company's website. As their team went through an evolution, we shifted the brand styles to feel more cohesive, as well as focused in on the many works Bliss has produced, and showcase what's previewing at upcoming festivals.

title: Courtesy Moto
description: A home for the up and coming motorcycle hub and historic space in the Five Points Neighborhood of Denver, Colorado. This was a full design and build for a coming soon page, as well a more layered commerce and scheduling platform, while helping this new local business find their brand and identity, without losing the fun and love of motorcycles.

title: Chessiverse Audit
description: A full audit of accessibility concerns and the user experience of the Chessiverse dashboard, courses, and gameplay overview. I provided visual feedback, documentation, and specific suggested fixes.

title: My Epic App
description: A complete redesign and rebuild of Vail Ski Resort’s My Epic mobile app. In tandem with Vail’s infrastructure, we introduced a new and innovative way for skiers to interact with over 30+ ski resorts and manage their Epic pass. My primary focus was on developing the SVG map, including custom styling and animated interactions, as well the development of trails and lifts pages and data, and ensuring clean user experience throughout.

title: Vidanta World
description: A new website for Vidanta World Resorts in Mexico. I was a part of the initial development team that built out all of the content models through Contentstack and developed the custom components their data would be piped into. These models were mapped to reusable pages so content managers could change the copy, images, and order of components with complete freedom, while keeping the integrity of the designs across the site.

title: Idea Builder
description: A platform for Merrill Lynch to help investors find stocks, ETFs, and Mutual Funds to invest in that align with their personal beliefs and value systems. I was a part of the team that developed this platform from initial design, creating a whole new design-system and component library. I was especially focused on the project meeting WCAG 2.1 AAA standards and building out charts and data visualizations.
